Kanishka Bombing Probe Nears End After 41 Years, Families Seek Answers

The investigation into the 1985 Kanishka bombing, which killed 329 people, is reportedly facing a shutdown after 41 years. Families of the victims are demanding answers and expressing fears that the case will go cold. The bombing resulted in one conviction. The probe's potential closure after over four decades has led to renewed calls for justice and accountability.
